headline: Stock markets end lower amid geopolitical uncertainty; Nifty down for 4th day - OrissaPOST
summary: Sensex and Nifty closed lower on Friday as elevated oil prices and the prolonged US-Iran impasse weighed on sentiment. The Sensex settled down 0.09% at 78,009.25.
why: The Sensex and Nifty are benchmark indices of India's largest listed companies and track domestic and global risk sentiment.
